summary: Selected mutated Pro Proposal 2, the finite adverse transducer/zero-gain-cycle route. Its causal mechanism requires every adverse seed to have a nonzero leading P-class before P^2 normalization can define transitions. The smallest prerequisite audit freezes the only integral defect map actually emitted by the N=8 NAND survivor. Exact SNF and a 334592-vector signed shell search find false boundaries 010, 100, and 111 with exact zero residual at anchor energies 64, 56, and 56. These witnesses are zero modulo P and P^2 and Frobenius-fixed. Thus the natural emitted-map instantiation is finitely falsified before COPY or cycle-mean construction; no claim is made about other quaternionic lifts or any asymptotic regime.
